assets.purpose: Chrome Web Store top promotional banner and README hero
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: official Chrome Web Store top promotional banner and GitHub README hero.
Transform a copy of the provided brand icon into a polished, wide promotional artwork for "Bookmark Navigation". The input image is the existing brand mark: three stacked indigo/violet rounded bookmark-card shapes, with subtle page tabs. Preserve that recognizable stacked-bookmark identity and indigo color family; do not redesign the actual extension icon.
Composition: create an ultra-wide 2.5:1 banner intended to be delivered at exactly 1400 by 560 pixels. Compose all meaningful content and text in the central safe area with generous margins, so a gentle final crop to that ratio preserves everything. Use a rich dark slate-blue background with subtle, restrained indigo lighting and crisp editorial contrast. On the left, very large clean modern sans-serif white title on two balanced lines, exactly "Bookmark" and "Navigation". Beneath it, a short legible line exactly "Browse. Organize. Ask AI." On the right, a premium dimensional illustration of the reference indigo stacked bookmark symbol with a few abstract floating bookmark cards, softly lit edges, calm depth and precise geometry. No real or invented application screenshot, no miniature UI, no browser chrome, no product feature claims beyond the supplied text.
Style: exceptionally clean official software launch art, elegant, confident, generous negative space, sophisticated slate/indigo palette. Matte surfaces and subtle gradients; no excessive sparkle, no loud neon.
Exact text only: "Bookmark Navigation" and "Browse. Organize. Ask AI." Ensure every letter is readable, correctly spelled, with no extra text.
Avoid: watermarks, extra logos, badges, ratings, prices, "free" claims, fake UI, small unreadable text, borders, transparency. Opaque full-bleed background.
